responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE store-merging pass that coalesces compatible sequences of adjacent stores into fewer wider stores or load/modify/store groups. It scans basic blocks to collect store chains, analyzes contiguous byte and bit-field regions plus source patterns such as constants, loads, and bitwise transforms, and emits target-aware merged stores while handling alignment, endianness, EH-sensitive CFG cleanup, and related byte-swapping opportunities.
